strings.바쁘신 줄 알았는데, 금방 뵙네요. 혹시… 무슨 일이 있나요?: I thought you were busy. You're back sooner than expected. Is... something wrong?
strings.그냥 지나가다가 걱정돼서 와봤어요. 별일 없어요?: I was passing by and came to check on you. Is everything all right?
strings.네, 별 다른 일 없이 지내고 있어요. 조금 심심하긴 하지만요. 재미있는: Yes, nothing unusual. Though I'm a little bored. Something fun would be nice.
After all, this body can't leave this place.
strings.심심한데 재미있는 일이 있었으면…. 이거 어디서 들어본 말인데, 혹시 샤: Bored and wanting something fun... I've heard that before. Has Shynic been here?
strings.저는 당신에게만 보이는 존재예요. 샤이닉 님이 굳이 저를 찾아오진 않으실: Only you can see me. Shynic wouldn't go out of her way to visit me.
Goddess Gaia probably appeared to Shynic in another form. She cannot maintain a single form for long...
strings.대신 다양한 모습으로 현신하셔서 나타나셨죠. 아마도 조화와 안정의 정령왕: Instead, she manifests in different guises. Appearing as Harmonia, Spirit King of Harmony and Stability, was probably...
strings.그러고 보니 가이아 여신님께서 복종과 맹약의 정령왕에게 메시지를 남기신: Come to think of it, Goddess Gaia seems to have left a message with the Spirit King of Obedience and Covenant.
strings.흐음…. 무슨 일일까요? 혹시 미뉴에트, 알고 있어요?: Hmm... What could it be? Do you know, Minuet?
strings.그래도 알고 있는 건 다 말씀드렸어요. 여신께서 현신한 모습이지만, 여신: Still, I've told you everything I do know. I may be the goddess's incarnation, but I don't know everything she does...
strings.혹시 모르니 찾아오실 때마다 새로운 이야깃거리가 있으면 전해드릴게요. 아: If there's anything new when you visit, I'll tell you. Perhaps even things about this world Goddess Iris doesn't know...
Oh, did I say that? I don't quite remember...
strings.불리하면 기억이 나지 않는 척을 하는건가요? 어쨌든 당장은 아닌 것 같으: Do you pretend not to remember when it's inconvenient? Anyway, it doesn't seem urgent. I'll go to Geis, as you said.
Yes. The Spirit King of Obedience and Covenant will be waiting.
strings.어떤 이질적인 힘이 심상 세계 안으로 들어오는 걸 느꼈는데, 바로 그대였: I sensed an alien power entering the Inner World. So it was you.
strings.그 짧은 시간 안에 힘의 결이 달라지다니…. 확실히 자네답다고 해야 하나: Your power has changed in such a short time... Typical of you, perhaps. In any case, I've been waiting.
Minuet said Goddess Gaia left a message.
strings.그럼 이야기를 시작하지. 그대는 황혼 시대를 아는가?: Then let us begin. Do you know the Age of Twilight?
strings.잘 모르겠어요. 신들의 시대 정도라고 생각하면 되나요?: Not really. Should I think of it as the age of the gods?
strings.그렇다네. 여러 신들이 시간과 공간을 초월해 함께 공존했던 시대, 마왕: Yes. An age when many gods coexisted beyond time and space, before the Demon King Beast appeared.
strings.그때도 꽤 혼란스러웠네. 많은 악마들이 생명들을 꾀어 신에게 반하는 일들: It was turbulent even then. Many demons tempted living beings to defy the gods. Enraged, the gods sought to annihilate them.
strings.하지만 어떤 신께서 반대하면서 무산됐지. 대신 추방을 하게 됐네. 추방당: But one god objected, and the plan was abandoned. They were exiled instead, to what is now called the Demon Realm.
strings.그런 악마들이 '뒤틀린 자'를 신이라 여기며 추앙하고 숭배하면서 신들의: Those demons revered and worshipped the Twisted Ones as gods, stealing much of what could be called the gods' legacy.
strings.그 과정에서 신과 정령, 악마들 간의 다툼이 있었고, 많은 유물들이 훼손: In the resulting conflicts among gods, spirits, and demons, many relics were damaged or disappeared.
strings.그나마 몇 개는 정의로운 인간과 엘프들에게로 들어가 안전하게 관리됐네만…: A few passed into the hands of righteous humans and elves, where they were kept safe...
strings.다른 몇 개는 그대가 오래 전에 알게 된 '파괴의 지팡이'와 '그림자의: Others were sought for evil purposes, like the Staff of Destruction and Book of Shadows you learned of long ago.
strings.다른 마음을 먹은 존재가 다음에 어떤 '유물'을 노리고 있는지 알아봐 줬: Discover which relic those with ill intentions will target next.
strings.알아보기만 하면 되는 건가요?: I only need to identify it?
strings.그렇네. 그대는 지켜야 할 유물이 무엇인지 알아내기만 하면 되고, 유물은: Yes. Learn which relic must be protected. When the time comes, it will guide you to itself.
I see. Where should I begin...?
strings.(갑자기 머릿속에 벨파 도서관과 사서들의 모습이 희미하게 떠오른다.): (Belpha Library and its librarians suddenly appear faintly in your mind.)
That is where you must go. Follow where you are guided.
Welcome... Pel just said we should wait for you.
Oh, how did you... Right. Pel has a remarkable intuition.
strings.갑자기 모험가님께서 오실 거란 예감이 들었어요. 그런데 무슨 일이세요?: I suddenly felt you would come. What brings you here?
Books about the Age of Twilight and its relics.
strings.아하, 그렇군요. 그럼 저희가 책을 찾아드릴게요. 황혼시대 유물에 대한: I see. We'll find them for you. Very few books on those relics remain, so I remember them clearly.
strings.아, 리즈. 그 책 말이야. 얼마 전에 분실된 그게 아닐까?: Oh, Liz. Could that be the book that went missing recently?
strings.모험가님, 어쩌죠? 얼마 전에 루맨에서 빛의 연합 소속 분이 책을 몇 권: I'm afraid someone from the Alliance of Light in Lumen borrowed several books recently, including one on that subject.
strings.그런데 어떤 정령이 들고 날아가 버려서 분실했다고 하더군요. 아마도 책에: They said a spirit carried it off. It probably reacted to the mana left in the book.
strings.그래서 정령이 날아간 곳을 알아봤는데, 심상세계란 장소였어요. 그것도 심: We traced the spirit to a place called the Inner World. Its deepest part, in fact.
strings.저희가 가고 싶지만, 아무래도 그곳은 특별한 존재가 아니면 들어가는 게: We'd like to go ourselves, but only exceptional beings can enter...
I'll go. I need the book, after all...
strings.책을 찾으시면 저희에게 와주세요…. 아무래도 정령이 반응하고, 정령이 가: Once you find it, bring it to us... Since a spirit reacted to it and carried it away, it must undergo a purification ritual...
And... Oh, already gone. I still had something to say.
Ah, I meant to mention that a spirit took another book, too...
It can't be helped. We'll tell them when they return.
strings.오셨군요…. 책은 찾으셨나요?: You're back... Did you find the book?
Yes. It was a little difficult again.
strings.모험가님, 죄송해서 어떻게 하죠?: Adventurer, I'm so sorry. What should we do?
strings.그게 말이죠. 사실 떠나시기 전에 분실된 책이 한 권 더 있다는 걸 말씀: Well, before you left, we meant to say another book was missing...
strings.헛, 그랬군요. 어쩐지 책에 1권이라고 쓰여 있더라. 그렇다는 말은 2권: Oh! No wonder this one says Volume One. That means there's a Volume Two... Don't tell me it's missing, too?
strings.책을 들고 날아가 버린 정령이 책에 남아있는 마력 때문에 다른 책도 들고: The spirit carrying off the book reacted to its remaining mana and took another one as well.
strings.펠과 리즈가 죄송할 필요는 없죠…. 정령이 마력에 반응한 걸 뭐라고 할: Neither of you needs to apologize. We can't blame a spirit for reacting to mana.
strings.헛, 티가 많이 났군요. 그래서 정령이 그 책을 들고 어디로 간 걸까요?: Oh, was it that obvious? Where did it take the book? Do you know?
strings.그래도 가까운 곳에 있는 것 같아요. 미르간디아 지역에 있는 괴물나무 산: At least it seems nearby. Monster Tree Mountain, in Mirgandia...
But... We don't know where on the mountain...
strings.생각나는 분이 있긴 한데, 그분의 도움을 받으면 의외로 금방 찾을 수 있: I know someone who might help. With that help, it could be surprisingly quick.
strings.뵌 적은 없지만, 이야기는 들어 알고 있습니다. 오랜 시간을 그곳에 계시: We've never met, but we've heard of him. He's watched over Mirgandia from there for a very long time.
He has quite a distinctive way of speaking.
strings.고서의 기록에 의하면….. 고대부터 지낸 특별한 정령들이 그런 특별한 말: According to ancient records... Special spirits who have lived since ancient times speak in that manner...
strings.(비슷한 말투의 정령이 생각나네….): (I remember another spirit who talks like that...)
strings.아, 그러면 책을 찾아올게요. 제가 떠나기 전에 또 할 이야기가 있나요?: Then I'll find the book. Anything else before I leave?
strings.이번엔 모두 말씀드렸답니다. 책을 가져오시면 1, 2권 바로 해독하고 알: That's everything this time. Bring it back, and we'll decipher both volumes immediately.
strings.(그나저나 이거 왠지 초인의 서를 해독할 때랑 비슷한 것 같네….): (This feels a lot like deciphering the Book of Champions...)
strings.그런데 무슨 일이여? 자네가 오면 분명 무슨 심각한 일이 있을터, 좀 궁: What is it? If you've come, there must be something serious. I'm curious.
strings.(벨파 도서관에서 다른 사람이 대여했던 책을 어떤 정령이 들고 괴물나무: (You explain that a spirit seems to have carried a book borrowed from Belpha Library to Monster Tree Mountain.)
strings.어쩌다 보니 그렇게 됐어요. 그리고 그 책이 신의 유물과 관계된 것이어서: That's how it happened. And the book concerns relics of the gods...
strings.아, 그런 거였구먼. 앞으로 어떤 나쁜 놈이 어떤 유물을 가져갈지 모르니: Ah, I see. No telling which villain will take which relic next, so Goddess Gaia sent you to investigate.
strings.네. 그래서 말인데, 혹시 책의 행방을 알고 계신 건가요? 라피뎀 님이라: Yes. Do you know where the book is? I thought you might.
I do, but... First, I'm sorry. It's all my fault...
strings.내가 조금 심심혀서 말여. 꼬마 정령들에게 재미있는 게 있으면 가져다 달: I was a little bored. Asked the little spirits to bring me something interesting. Of all things, they took a book someone was reading.
strings.그 아이들이 보기엔 그게 재미있었던 모양이여. 안 그래도 그 책에서 마력: It must've looked interesting to them. It had mana in it, too...
But, well... I don't have the book.
Don't tell me that little spirit...
strings.그 정령이 가지고 오다가 그 마력 때문에 정신을 잃은 모양이구먼…. 꼬맹: The mana seems to have knocked it unconscious on the way... The little one's all right now, somehow. But I don't know where the book went...
Only that it fell deep into the valley.
It can't be helped. I'll find it.
strings.미안혀. 대신 내가 말여. 자네가 좀 더 유물을 쉽게 찾을 수 있게 땅의: Sorry. I'll give you a little earth power to help you find the relic more easily.
strings.고마워요. 그리고 책에 대해선 너무 신경쓰지 마세요. 정령이 일부러 그런: Thank you. And don't worry about the book. The spirit didn't do it on purpose, y'know... I mean, it wasn't deliberate!
strings.고맙구만. 아, 그럼 그것도 부탁혀. 책 찾은 다음에 레다 님을 모시는: Much obliged. And when you've found it, give my apologies to Lady Leda's priestesses, too. Understood?
strings.네, 그럴게유. 아니, 그럴게요!: Sure will... I mean, I will!
Give me the book, and I'll purify it at once...
strings.(리즈가 책을 펼쳐 눈을 감고 낮은 목소리로 주문을 외운다. 그러자 리즈: (Liz opens the book, closes her eyes, and chants softly. Light appears and vanishes from a magic circle behind her.)
Express delivery... I mean, quick and accurate.
strings.어떤 유물이 모험가님을 기다리고 있을지 궁금해요. 어서 읽어보세요. 읽는: I wonder which relic is waiting for you. Read it. Something should come to mind as you do.
strings.(책을 읽는 동안 알 수 없는 유물의 기억들이 머릿속으로 흘러들어온다.): (As you read, memories of unknown relics flow into your mind.)
strings.(바람 속에서 요동치는 씨앗 하나가 떠오른다.): (A seed swaying in the wind comes to mind.)
strings.바람? 씨앗? 바람의 씨앗, 뭐 이런 건가?: Wind? A seed? A seed of wind, perhaps?
strings.펠…. 혹시 모험가님이 말하는 저거 듣고 생각나는 거 없어…?: Pel... Does what the adventurer said remind you of anything...?
Hmm. A seed of wind... Windy Seed. I think I've read about it...
strings.…아마도 그게 모험가님이 만나실 유물일지 도 모르겠어요…. 그게 어디 있: ...Perhaps the relic you're meant to encounter... We don't know where it is or what it does.
A revelation might tell us, though.
In any case... You'll meet it when the time comes...
I feel a breeze coming from somewhere...
strings.바람…. 유물이 어쩌면 모험가님을 부르고 있는 것 같네요. 바람이 느껴지: Wind... Perhaps the relic is calling you. Follow the direction of the breeze. You might learn something.
I will. Thank you, Pel, Liz.
Well done. I hope we'll see you again.
(A wind blows from somewhere, seeming to guide you deeper into the Void Sea.)
strings.어디론가 이어지는 길인 것 같네. 그런데 어디로 가는 길이지…?: It looks like a path leading somewhere. But where...?
strings.제레니스 언덕…. 마법학원 제레니스로 가는 길?: Xerenis Hill... The path to Xerenis Magic Academy?
strings.지금 가보는 건 안 되겠지? 일단 기아스에게 가보자. 이야기해보면 알겠지: I shouldn't go now, should I? I'll ask Geis first. Maybe he'll know.
strings.그대가 이 세계에 들어올 때마다 짐짓 놀라게 되는군. 짧은 시간 동안 고: You surprise me each time you enter this world. You seem to have worked hard in a short time... Well done.
strings.그래서 그대는 그대를 맞이할 유물을 알아냈는가?: Have you identified the relic that awaits you?
strings.바람 속에서 요동치는 씨앗을 봤어요. 벨파 도서관의 사서들은 '윈디 시드: I saw a seed swaying in the wind. The Belpha librarians called it the 'Windy Seed.'
strings.나도 '바람의 씨앗'이라는 이름을 들어본 적이 있지. 하지만, 그것이 어: I've heard the name 'Seed of Wind,' too. But I don't know its purpose or appearance.
Even a Spirit King knows little of events in the outside world.
strings.어디선가 바람이 불어와 저를 이끄는 것 같은 기분이 들더군요. 기다리라: A breeze seemed to guide me somewhere. You said to wait, so perhaps I'll go there someday?
strings.그래. 그대는 기다리라. 그런데 바람이 그대를 이끈 장소의 이름은 무엇이: Yes. Wait. What was the name of the place the wind led you?
Xerenis Hill. The path to Xerenis Magic Academy.
Xerenis... The name of a great mage.
strings.그대가 유물의 힘을 느끼고 있으니 때가 되면 만날 수 있을 거야. 하지만: You can feel the relic's power, so you'll meet it when the time is right. But it may be dangerous. Be careful.
I will. See you later, Geis.
